name: Drawnix
tagline: Freehand, mind maps and flowcharts on one infinite canvas — saved on this device.
description:
A whiteboard that holds a mind map, a flowchart and a pencil sketch on the same infinite canvas, so you do not have to open three tools to finish one thought.

Draw boxes and arrows, grow a mind map from the keyboard, or just scribble. Undo, redo, copy, paste, zoom and pan all work the way a board should. Drop in a picture. Export a PNG, an SVG or a Drawnix file when you want a copy in your hands. Paste a text flowchart and it becomes boxes and arrows; paste a Markdown outline and it becomes a mind map.

The board auto-saves on this device — there is no cloud copy. Close the window, open it later, the canvas is where you left it.

An unofficial port of Drawnix by plait-board, MIT-licensed.
